arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Bruck stated the Court considers South Carolina's compliance with Simmons.
Mr. Waters stated Simmons created a limited due process exception.
Mr. Waters stated the general rule allows states to decide on parole disclosure.
Mr. Bruck noted the history of South Carolina's handling is detailed in the petition.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests a due process exception to the general rule. States usually decide whether juries learn about parole. the side that brought the case claims this rule applies here. The state claims it retains full control over jury instructions.
